title: HomePi Runtime Override Configuration
description: Schema for runtime overrides applied after defaults, runtime config, service config, module config, and environment variables.

target.description: Service or module target receiving the override.

reason.description: Human-readable explanation for why this override exists.

expiresAt.description: Optional expiration time for temporary overrides.

overrides.description: Override payload. Must be validated against the target service/module schema after merge.
